title: Meshed slotted arms and inclined guides
question: Drive P down-right. Determine the motion of Q (diagonal) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive P down-right. External mesh A/B (14/28 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative. At top dead vertical, the radial slot transmits horizontal velocity to the SE guide. A positive, P positive. At top dead vertical, the radial slot transmits horizontal velocity to the SW guide. B negative, Q positive. The requested motion is down-left (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: Q must be down-left. At top dead vertical, the radial slot transmits horizontal velocity to the SW guide. B negative, Q positive..

options.label: B
options.explanation: Q must be down-left. At top dead vertical, the radial slot transmits horizontal velocity to the SW guide. B negative, Q positive..

options.label: C
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: D
options.explanation: Q must be down-left. At top dead vertical, the radial slot transmits horizontal velocity to the SW guide. B negative, Q positive..
